timeline.summary: 21 Apr 2026: PNC Infratech emerged L1 bidder for two NHAI HAM projects on NH-927 in Uttar Pradesh with an aggregate bid project cost of ₹3,483 Cr, exclusive of GST.
On May 5, 2026, PNC Infratech accepted NHAI's ₹234.72 Cr settlement offer for the Agra Bypass Project arbitration award under the Vivad-se-Vishwas III Scheme.
7 May 2026: PNC Infratech emerged L1 bidder for a ₹194.40 Cr EPC flyover at Shaheed Path, Lucknow, for Lucknow Development Authority, with a 24-month completion period.
NSE Sustainability Ratings and Analytics assigned PNC Infratech an independent ESG rating of 49 for FY25.

On 8 May 2026, PNC Infratech announced that its subsidiary Prayagraj Kaushambi Highway Package 3 Private Limited received the provisional completion certificate for the ₹819 Cr NH-731A HAM project effective 31 March 2026.
9 May 2026: PNC Infratech notified a board meeting on 19 May 2026 to approve audited standalone and consolidated FY26 results and consider a dividend, if any.
Declared L1 bidder in a 50:50 JV for a ₹571.81 Cr 4-lane Ganga bridge EPC project by UP State Bridge Corporation.
Received Letter of Acceptance for ₹559.53 Cr Ganga river bridge EPC project from UP State Bridge Corporation Ltd.
PNC Infratech reported Q4FY26 financial results; and completed divestment of its 12th road asset SPV.
PNC Infratech reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹5,368 Cr and an order book of over ₹18,094 Cr.
PNC Infratech Limited shared the audio recording of its Q4FY26 earnings conference call held on May 20, 2026, with investors and analysts.
PNC Infratech received Letters of Acceptance from NHAI for two HAM highway projects worth ₹3,483 Cr.
PNC Infratech hosted its Q4FY26 earnings conference call on 20th May 2026, guiding for ~30% revenue growth in FY27 to ₹6,000 Cr.
PNC Infratech emerged as L1 bidder for the Airports Authority of India's Pantnagar Airport EPC project, quoted at ₹302.44 Cr excluding GST with a 24-month completion period.
PNC Infratech received a formal LOA for a ₹194.40 Cr flyover EPC project from Lucknow Development Authority on June 1, 2026.
On October 13, 2026, PNC Infratech announced that the Delhi High Court stayed NHAI's debarment orders against the company and Awadh Expressway Private Limited.
